name: Generate keyword ideas from Google, YouTube and Amazon autocomplete in Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## 🔍 Keyword content-idea engine from live autocomplete

### Who's it for
SEO and content teams who want real, current autocomplete phrases — the queries people actually type — in a spreadsheet pipeline instead of a point-and-click tool subscription.

### How it works
Enter seed keywords (comma-separated) and pick your sources: **Google, YouTube, Amazon, Bing** — any mix. A hosted Apify actor (called over plain HTTP) queries each engine's live autocomplete and returns the merged, de-duplicated suggestions per seed. A Code node explodes them into one row per idea — seed, idea, sources, date — and appends everything to your Google Sheet, ready for clustering, briefs or Ads planning.

### Requirements
- An [Apify](https://apify.com) account + API token
- A Google account for Sheets

Cost is [$0.01 per seed keyword that returns ideas](https://apify.com/beacondata/keyword-research-scraper) — a 20-seed research session costs **$0.20**, typically returning hundreds of phrases. Seeds with no results are never charged, and the call carries a hard $1 cost cap.

### How to customize
Add Bing to the sources, set the `country` for localized results, schedule a weekly run per content cluster, or chain an AI node after the sheet to group ideas by intent.

## 🛠 How to set up

1. **Create an Apify account** at [apify.com](https://apify.com) (takes a minute, card not required) and copy your API token from **Console → Settings → API & Integrations**.
2. **Create the credential:** in n8n choose **Create credential → Header Auth** and set
   - Name: `Authorization`
   - Value: `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN` (paste the token you copied in place of YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN)
   then select it on **Fetch Autocomplete Ideas**.
3. **Open **Config**** and set your own values.
4. Pick your **Google Sheets** credential on the last node and choose the spreadsheet + sheet to append to.
5. Run it once with the test button, check the output, then activate.
